## 2.0 Beta 1
Complete overhaul of the UI. With the desire to reflect information more clearly, and make tasks more obvious, both the look, and how you interact with the module, has changed.
New effects: Auto Wah, Bounce Pan and Noise Gate.
New: Screen saver, with fun bonus of reacting to incoming audio
New: Meters in the Input and Output gain single knob screens.
New: Peak Hold Indicators on all meters
Fixed: Cases where data was written to flash when it did not need to be written.
Fixed: Possible wrong BPM and PPQN at boot.
Fixed: Certain cases where Compressor, Shimmer and Shimmer Storm didn’t start in the state their default values show.
Fixed: Turning a knob in Quick Settings could change effect parameters.

notes: Clock & Duck inputs: short triggers are no longer missed — caught on arrival instead of once per audio block; clock is more stable, timed to within a fraction of a sample, with slightly lower CPU load
BPM display: steadier — shows whole BPM and no longer flickers between two values
Fixed: Ping Pong could produce NaNs in its feedback loop, leaving the effect broken until reset; the same protection now covers every other effect whose feedback loop could run away
Fixed: Ping Pong left/right balance
Fixed: an effect parameter could keep a modulation offset after nothing was modulating it
Fixed: some reverbs reset some of their values when selected, leaving them out of step with their parameters
Fixed: screen now starts up even if USB was powered before the module
Ladder Filter, Tape Reel & Spring Verb: lower CPU usage (should sound the same)
Please test CERN: its working memory has moved to a different area of RAM — if you hear dropouts or overload with CERN in a heavy line-up, please report it
To help catch possible issues in the field, Added code to check for NaN and Inf values being generated, and report them on the display
Updated compiler to C++17
NEW: Gain Screen — Input Gain added, Output Gain moved to Gain Screen

NEW: Comb Filter effect

Sweeper & Tape Deck: optimized — lower CPU usage
CERN: major internal cleanup
Studder: fixed marker placements
Fixed: Factory Presets bug
